metadata.method: 2018 onboard/minimap and firsthand source photography, with separately dated2023 event-use evidence. World-relative appearance estimates, not a new road survey.
metadata.approximation: Manual plan-view placement; boundaries, off-road elevation and individual tree positions/heights are not surveyed.
metadata.localAxes: x east, y south, metres in TrackMath built-track coordinates.
limitations: Venue-operator construction drawings were not located. MotorKlasse/Encar support appearance; AWAK supports a separately dated event-use record.
2018 publication is historical; capture year is not independently confirmed.
Pit paddock is not repainted; bare-earth shoulder colour is shown but soil mounds are not surveyed or separately reconstructed.
Concrete pit wall is not treated as a retaining wall.

The provided150s MotorKlasse video was uploaded2018-10-29 and drives opposite the stored canonical path. All side labels are converted; the existing simulation direction/road/elevation/length/timing are retained.

The video minimap matches the shared course with about1.06px RMS, but a northwest triangular extension is absent from the stored road. New close facilities are omitted at canonical980–1160m. Fit quality is not physical boundary accuracy; interval endpoints are approximately30m uncertain.

White corrugated barriers are PVC according to the firsthand2018 report, distinct from grey/hazard-painted concrete safety walls and tyre barriers. A structural retaining-wall function is not established for the photographed pit safety wall.

Reed-like clumps reproduce tall dry herbaceous growth, without botanical species or wetland identification. Individual stem positions, density, heights and soil colours are visual estimates. Existing photo-backed woodland remains separate; random infield trees are disabled.
AWAK documents a2023-01-17 test event; the user also confirms ongoing facility use. These support driving/event-use classification, without asserting a current daily public-opening timetable.
